decision.reason: [ev-68a10264f91d] is a single changelog bug-fix line saying only that duplicate logs from docker containers were fixed. It doesn't say which component or setup produced the duplicates, how the fix works, or whether operators will see a change such as lower log volume. So the evidence can't settle whether this is a behavior-change to review or just an informational fix (none), and nothing supports the "medium" severity. The description or diff of PR 11563 is needed to decide the consequence.
